name: What insulation is required for garage conversions?

mainEntity.name: What insulation is required for garage conversions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Walls, ceiling, and floor must meet California Energy Code (R-19 walls, R-38 ceiling, R-10 slab edge typical); vapor barriers prevent moisture from concrete slab.
